notes: Background is cool charcoal #2C2C32 — not pitch black.
Several line cores measure higher S/V than day (Victoria, Central, H&C, Circle); others gain mostly from contrast on dark paper.
Piccadilly is lifted (mid navy) vs brand deep blue for night contrast.
Northern uses black fill + white outline/label treatment.
National Rail remains pinkish but darker than day.
Cable car not a clear inactive-grey corridor in this frame; some red near Greenwich may be Central or faint service paint.

background.note: Use charcoal paper, never #000 map chrome for night Go-like surfaces.
background.dominant_note: Most common map paper (~1.1M px at 1800px max-side). Cool charcoal, not #000.

perception_vs_measurement.user_feel: Brighter and more saturated than day
perception_vs_measurement.absolute_lab_hsv: About half of compared families show +ΔS and/or +ΔV vs day samples (Victoria, Central, H&C, Circle strongest).
perception_vs_measurement.relative_contrast: Dark charcoal paper (#2C2C32) raises perceived pop even when absolute V is similar or lower (Overground, NR, Piccadilly).
perception_vs_measurement.piccadilly_strategy: Brand #0019A8 is too dark on charcoal — Go lifts to mid navy (~#2A437C) for legibility.
perception_vs_measurement.northern_strategy: Near-black fill (#000/#141415) plus abundant near-white (#FCFCFC) for outline/labels — black alone would vanish.
perception_vs_measurement.national_rail: Still pinkish; night value drops (#D8A0AE day → ~#946070) so it stays secondary to Tube paints.
perception_vs_measurement.thames: Day pale blue fill → night darker slate (#343438 / mean #47494D), only slightly lighter than paper.
